main.description: An industrial property right: patent, utility model, design, or trademark (researchmap 産業財産権). Not folded into pub.paper.reference despite CSL having a 'patent' type, because the CV-relevant facts are the three distinct numbers a patent acquires as it moves through prosecution -- application, publication, registration -- and a bibliographic record has nowhere to put a lifecycle. Japanese practice cites the application number (特願) long before anything is granted, so `applicationNumber` alone is a valid record.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or 'WO' for PCT and 'EP' for European applications.

applicationNumber.description: e.g. '特願2020-001413', 'US 17/123,456'. Usually the only number that exists for years.

registrationNumber.description: e.g. '特許第1234567号'. Present only once granted.

inventors.description: Inventor names on a filed patent are already public record, so consent concerns do not apply here as they do in id.career.supervision.

applicants.description: 出願人. Usually the university or company, not the inventors.

familyMembers.description: StrongRefs to other id.career.patent records in the same patent family (national-phase entries of one PCT application). Prevents one invention from being padded into ten CV lines.

relatedWork.description: StrongRef to a pub.paper.reference for the paper covering the same work.

url.description: J-PlatPat, Google Patents, or Espacenet link.
